purpose: Development-only integration and scorer calibration subset mapped from an existing committed benchmark.
cluster_id_policy: Source rows do not define clusters; the harness defaults each cluster_id to item_id. Future related variants must share an explicit cluster_id.

source_mappings.selection_rule: All 24 Turkish rows plus the first 24 English rows in committed file order; IDs are explicit below.

limitations: This is a retrieval-derived development subset, not an untouched provider-evaluation test set.
It contains no safety, adversarial, or planner-veto items.
It may be used to verify integration and calibrate scorers but never to authorize a default-provider switch.
